basics.name: Ivan Shakhorski
basics.summary: A highly skilled Software Engineer with over four years of experience in commercial software development, specializing in frontend development with Vue.js and possessing a deep understanding of API design and integration. Proven high expertise in building various web applications. Experience in backends using Node.js. Measurable contributions to e-commerce, machine learning, social network, and government domains. Passionate about creating impactful user experiences and driving business outcomes.

work.name: Innowise
work.summary: Led the development of high-performance web applications across e-commerce, government, machine learning, and marketing domains. Designed scalable frontend architectures using Vue.js, mentored junior developers, and optimized CI/CD processes.
highlights: Led development of high-performance web applications across diverse domains.
Designed and implemented scalable frontend architectures.
Mentored junior developers and enhanced team proficiency.
Streamlined CI/CD processes using Docker, TeamCity, and cloud services.
Implemented automation testing with Cypress, Vitest, and Jest.
